note: Wayne County MO (29223): the county's Hub open-data site lists no zoning dataset (search API returns zero hits for zoning). The SEMO GIS server (maps.semogis.com) hosts no Wayne County folder; neighbouring Iron County's zoning is there but not Wayne's. Piedmont, the largest city, zones under Chapter 17 with its zoning map kept by the City Clerk, not as a queryable service. The 'Piedmont Zoning Viewer' found is an Oklahoma city's viewer. Regrid has zoning fields but is a commercial third-party copy, not an official service.
